name: Hip 1443
sale: Keeneland September Yearling Sale 2026 — consigned by Lane’s End, Agent
notes: Golden Pal (Uncle Mo) was a brilliant racehorse himself (8-2-0 in 13, $1.8M+, multiple G1s incl. a Breeders' Cup Turf Sprint) but is early at stud — this filly is from his 2nd crop; his 1st-crop 2yos are just showing modest juvenile placings in 2026, nothing graded yet. His first-crop yearlings averaged $139,184 at Keeneland September last year. Dam Jazzique (IRE) is herself graded-placed (3rd, Miss Grillo S. G2) — not a blank slate. The female family is exceptional: 3rd dam Lagrion was Irish Broodmare of the Year in both 2006 and 2007, dam of Dylan Thomas (IRE) — Horse of the Year, Irish Derby, Irish Champion S. x2, King George VI & Queen Elizabeth S., Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe — plus Queen's Logic (G1 Cheveley Park, champion 2yo filly) and Homecoming Queen (G1 1000 Guineas). A more recent generation produced G1 winner Sahlan. Three individual Group/Grade 1 winners within 3 generations. $175,000 is a real premium over Golden Pal's yearling average, but pages this decorated regularly bring far more once the sire is established — his still-modest $20-25K fee likely kept this restrained.
